scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Establish the high-cardinality fixture oracle
cases.input_contract: Compute input row count, distinct key count and total id sum. Confirm the key formula supports exactly 20 occurrences per key.
cases.expected: Metrics(20000,1000,199990000);keys 0..999 each occur 20 times by construction.
cases.verification: Assert the aggregate tuple and independent arithmetic sum 0+...+19999.

cases.title: Build and execute a controlled grouped query
cases.input_contract: Require 1..16 shuffle partitions, set that configuration in the owned session and return key, n from groupBy/count. Execute the two-partition case under the supplied unique job group.
cases.expected: Sorted output[(0,20),...,(999,20)], with total counts 20000 and an Exchange in the executed plan.
cases.verification: Assert every key/count pair and the plan Exchange marker. Reject an out-of-budget partition request.

cases.title: Read actual exchange metrics after the action
cases.input_contract: Traverse the executed classic Spark plan, collecting each Exchange metric map. Use the version-pinned internal diagnostic API only for evidence after collection.
cases.expected: One exchange map for this aggregate, with numPartitions 2 and dataSize>0. Record other available metrics without inventing units or missing values.
cases.verification: Assert one observed exchange, its partition metric and positive serialized data size;print the complete available map.

cases.title: Attach stage and task evidence to the named action
cases.input_contract: Use the status tracker to find jobs for a supplied group and their retained stages. Return stage_id, num_tasks, completed_tasks, failed_tasks ordered by stage identity.
cases.expected: Nonempty retained stage evidence for the p2 action, including a stage with 2 tasks. All task counters are nonnegative.
cases.verification: Assert nonempty stage rows and a two-task stage, and print the actual counters rather than asserting a universal stage count.

cases.title: Change reduce parallelism while preserving the complete result
cases.input_contract: Run the same source aggregation with 5 shuffle partitions under its own job group. Compare all 1000 group tuples, then report exchange and stage evidence tied to p5.
cases.expected: Exact output matches p2 and the literal oracle. Exchange numPartitions 5 and positive dataSize;retained task evidence includes a five-task stage.
cases.verification: Assert result parity before inspecting the 5-partition metric and corresponding action-group stages.

cases.title: Separate a workload model from measured evidence
cases.input_contract: For the declared 20000-row,1000-key, four-mapper fixture, return source_rows_per_mapper, partial_group_upper and average_output_groups_per_reducer for a positive reducer count. Label them as arithmetic estimates and print version/configuration beside the actual metrics.
cases.expected: For reducers 2:5000,4000,500. For reducers 5:5000,4000,200. These values do not assert actual balanced hash buckets or network bytes.
cases.verification: Assert the two model tuples and print Spark 4.0.1, AQEfalse, local[2] with the distinct p2/p5 observations.

golden.metrics_scope: Actual executed classic Spark4.0.1 Exchange metrics;dataSize is serialized exchange data,not claimed remote network bytes.
